Name: Say No to Demetrius' Farm Cave Project
Author: QuillSnow
Description:
[size=3]This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]Farm Cave Framework[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to allow you to tell Demetrius you don't want him messing with your farm cave. It also changes his dialogue to reflect you refusing to let him set up the cave, because it would be pretty strange for him to just barrel ahead with his default spiel about how he'll set up the cave for you when you haven't allowed him to do so.

To enable the changes I needed to make to the farm cave event, I have added a config that allows you to enable or disable my event changes. This has the added benefit of giving you an easy way to disable the mod's event edit if you want mushrooms, bats, or any other custom farm cave bounty. To do this, I highly recommend you install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], if you haven't already.

[/size][size=5][color=#b4a7d6]Installation Requirements
[/color][/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Content Patcher[/size]
[*][size=3]Farm Cave Framework[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][color=#b4a7d6]How to Install
[/color][/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Download the latest version of this mod from the Files Tab[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip to your Mods folder[/size]
[*][size=3]To uninstall, simply delete the mod from your folder and reset the farm event using Farm Cave Framework's GMCM option.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][color=#b4a7d6]Credits
[/color][/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]This mod is the meme-y result of Dominic and fork's musings in the Stardew Valley Discord! Many thanks to them for putting the idea in my head in the first place.[/size]
[*][size=3]Shoutout to my good friend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]Airyn[/url]﻿ for helping me understand how to get this mod to work! He has made many wonderful mods for SDV that, among other things, help improve diversity in many ways, so be sure to give his profile a browse here on Nexus or on [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/profile/182160]ModDrop[/url]﻿! (Note: His wonderful Diverse Stardew Valley suite of character portraits and seasonal outfits is exclusively on his ModDrop!)
[/size]
[/list]
